label: UserStory-1
title: As a developer, I want to edit issues in the UI
description:
## User Story

**As a** developer working on a project,
**I want to** edit issue details directly in the UI,
**So that** I can update issues without manually editing JSON files.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Can edit title, description, status
- [ ] Can add/remove tags
- [ ] Can add comments
- [ ] Changes persist to .issues folder
- [ ] Can see markdown preview of description
